style.checked_requirement: Vivid citron/aubergine authored lithographic illustration with restrained burnt-orange touch points; large real-habit plant forms and adult hands.
observations: Citron field, aubergine typography/stems/table, orange hands and pot, lithographic grain and restrained hatch are visible.
Both leaf faces are predominantly green, an observed deviation from the assigned aubergine ink emphasis.

ratio.policy: Permitted nearest-integer one-edge rounding; no resizing.

observations: Compact branching oval-leaf plant and broad fenestrated-leaf plant differ in habit and scale.
Upper adult hand holds/touches a compact plant leaf; lower right adult hand wraps around orange pot; pots stand on shared oblique table.
All syllables read with mature proportions, visible counters and stable baselines; body retains meaningful Korean word spaces.
At 720 the regular paragraph and practical lines can be followed; English/URL are smaller but readable in this displayed view.
Title is immediately distinct at thumbnail; bold leaf silhouettes and hands carry the right half.
Same left start links eyebrow/title/companion/subtitle to whole paragraph, then date/hours/place; access/care pair and invitation/URL continue below.
The shared table and differing plant reaches organize the illustration with the typography; plants are substantial active content rather than tiny added decoration.
Upper thumb/index overlap an intact leaf while stems continue to soil.
Right hand wraps pot front/side, with distinguishable finger contours; visible pot rim and stems remain legible.
The hand is lower on the pot side than the suggested thumb-at-rim detail, but support is readable; guide geometry is flexible.
Controlled jagged printed leaf edges and vein cuts; speckle sits on leaves/pots/table while small text remains separate.
Some leaflet boundaries overlap intentionally; no broken pot/table footing or floating stem observed.
